name: Aesthetic-Usability Effect
axiom: Polished interfaces are judged more usable than plain ones that do the same work.
trigger: A restyle changes only color, type, and spacing; testers still rate the product easier to use and stop noticing its flaws.

checklist.text: Derive every margin, padding, and gap from one 4 or 8 pixel scale; no arbitrary values.
Align text baselines and control edges to shared guides, and check the page at 100 percent zoom.
Draw border radii, shadow levels, and neutral colors from one token file.
Test perceived usability separately from task completion; a high aesthetic score is not task success.

antiPattern.violation: An analytics product ships default browser buttons, misaligned table columns, and unstyled alert text.
antiPattern.remediation: It uses tabular figures, one radius scale, and a neutral ramp, with spacing tokens shared across the product.
